verdict.rationale: Paperspace documents Notebooks as a web-based Jupyter IDE backed by accelerated compute, and says you can connect to remote Jupyter kernels through alternative IDEs. Machines support SSH connections from the console or desktop app. However, nothing shows a one-step VS Code/Cursor connect flow, and one hands-on user described SSH access as an uphill battle with outdated docs. missing for 10: explicit one-click/one-step IDE connection, named VS Code/Cursor integration, Jupyter launch on Machines (not just Notebooks), independent corroboration of a smooth connect experience.
